PARLIAMENTARY ELECTIONS ACT, No. 1 OF 1981

IN the exercise of the powers vested in me by Section 6 (1) of the Parliamentary Elections Act, No. 1 of 1981, I, MahindaDeshapriya, Commissioner of Elections do by this Notice appoint the persons mentioned in Column II of the Schedule heretoas Assistant Returning Officers to assist the Returning Officer of the Electoral District specified in the correspondingentry in Column I of the Schedule in the performance of the duties of such Returning Officer in connection with theParliamentary General Election to be held on 17th August, 2015.
MAHINDA DESHAPRIYA,Commissioner of Elections.Elections Secretariat,Sarana Mawatha,Rajagiriya.09th August, 2015.Schedule
